items.title: RedAmon AI Tool that Chains Reconnaissance, Exploitation, and Post-exploitation
items.description: A new open-source offensive security platform called RedAmon is redefining automated penetration testing by chaining reconnaissance, exploitation, post-exploitation, AI-driven triage, and automated code remediation all into a single end-to-end pipeline that culminates in a GitHub pull request with the fix already written.
